cpt.scene.consult.name: Consultation waiting tone

cpt.scene.three_party.name: Three-party waiting tone

cpt.scene.transfer.name: Transfer tone
cpt.scene.transfer.desc: Plays once to the customer after the agent confirms a blind transfer; stops immediately when the transfer completes or fails.
